text: The formation rule for Π types Π(x:A).B(x) requires:
choices: A : Type_i and B(x) : Type_i for x:A
A and B to have the same type
explanation: Π-formation: Γ ⊢ A : U_i and Γ, x:A ⊢ B(x) : U_i, then Γ ⊢ Π(x:A).B(x) : U_i. Both A and the fibers B(x) must be types in the same (or compatible) universe.
